pipeline: RarePath bounded sequence-guided AlphaFold C-alpha comparison

method.name: sequence_guided_ca_superposition_horn_quaternion_v0.1
method.coordinate_selection: PDB C-alpha atoms mapped by affine local alignment
method.rigid_fit_objective: minimize sum_i ||R*x_i + t - y_i||^2 with R a proper rotation
method.solver: Horn quaternion least-squares fit; 4x4 symmetric eigenproblem solved by Jacobi rotations
